Let me consider this question about Hans Holbein the Younger.

Hans Holbein the Younger (c. 1497-1543) was a German-Swiss painter who became famous for his portraits. He is most notably associated with the court of Henry VIII of England, where he served as the King's Painter from around 1536 until his death in 1543. He created many iconic portraits of Henry VIII, his wives (including Anne of Cleves), and members of the Tudor court.

All four agents agree on Henry VIII with very high confidence (0.98-1.00), and this aligns perfectly with the well-established historical record. This is one of the most famous artist-patron relationships in art history.

Answer: Henry VIII
Confidence: 0.99
